Ensure the athlete maintains a consistent sleep schedule, aiming for 7-8 hours per night. Focus on quality sleep to support recovery and readiness for future efforts.
Continue monitoring heart rate variability (HRV) and resting heart rate (RHR) to gauge overall recovery status. Aim for stable or improving HRV and RHR readings.
Consider incorporating some active recovery days to help with recovery and prevent staleness. These could be short, easy sessions on rest days or light cross-training activities.
